# Code of Conduct

sigwood adopts the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/),
version 2.1.

In short: be civil. Argue about code, log formats, and detection as much as you like.
Harassment, personal attacks, and unwelcome attention are not part of that.

This applies to issues, pull requests, and any other project space.

To report a problem, email **code@augros.org**. Reports go to the maintainer and stay
private.
